column1: # EPOCHS x MIN-LR 2D sweep on the M03 and Q02 bases. NOT YET LAUNCHED.
# ⛔ BLOCKED ON THE CHECKPOINT SWEEP (18241798), DELIBERATELY. An epochs sweep judged on
# `best_model.pth` is STRUCTURALLY BIASED toward more epochs: selection is val_pearson_delta,
# which oscillates +/-0.20 between consecutive epochs (F7), so a 90-epoch arm gets 3x the draws
# against that noise independent of model quality. It would measure "more lottery tickets" and
# read as "longer training is better". The checkpoint sweep decides the measurement protocol:
#   cell-eval picks a DIFFERENT, BETTER checkpoint -> select every arm on cell-eval
#   SAME checkpoint                                -> best_metric is fine, sweep as normal
#   different but NOT better                       -> selection is noise; judge at final_model.pth
# WHY 2D. F-sched1 moved epochs 30->60 AND eta_min 1e-7->1e-5 TOGETHER and gained +0.0073
# (M03), +0.0186 (M06), +0.0150 (Q02) -- the largest win of the campaign and the only
# intervention to improve all four metrics at once. But nothing in it says WHICH knob did the
# work. Crossing them separates that, and the INTERACTION is the interesting cell: a high floor
# may pay off only with long training, or only with short.
# VARIED: epochs {30, 60, 90} x eta_min {1e-7, 1e-6, 1e-5, 1e-4}. 30 and 1e-7 are the current
# defaults; 60 and 1e-5 are F-sched1's combination; the grid spans two decades either side.
# HELD FIXED per base: M03 = dcos 0.01, no mag, no latent. Q02 = dcos 0.5, mag 0.01363,
# latent MSE 0.0044. Everything else arm s313, seed 42.
# READ AGAINST (test, uncalibrated, 5/5): Q02 0.3783/0.0225/0.0774/0.7029 ·
# ANCHORS: meanpert 0.1324 · transfer 0.2323 · experimental 0.3722 (mae 0.0257).
# `mae` is an ERROR: LOWER IS BETTER.
# PRE-REGISTERED. Gain tracks epochs at every floor -> it is training length, and eta_min is
# incidental. Gain tracks eta_min at every length -> it is the floor, and F-sched1's extra
# epochs were wasted compute. Only the (long, high-floor) corner wins -> genuine interaction and
# neither knob can be tuned alone. 90 no better than 60 -> 60 is the plateau.
# ⚠️ EPOCHS AND ETA_MIN ARE PASSED PER-ROW, via the last two columns, NOT via the EPOCHS/ETA_MIN
# env vars the launcher also supports -- those are global to a job and cannot vary across a grid.
# The launcher needs a small change to read them per row before this can run.
# SPLIT ACROSS QOS: the M03 half runs on one qos and the Q02 half on the other, so a
# per-qos problem cannot take out one whole base and leave the comparison half-measured.
